name: PT Futura Energi Global Tbk
summary: PT Futura Energi Global Tbk provides construction support services in Indonesia. It operates through Trading and Construction Support Services, Advertising and Consulting, Data Services, Product Development, and Creative Warehouse segments. The company offers oil and gas services to the offshore and onshore oil and gas sectors; renewable energy solutions, such as micro hydropower generators and turbine servicing; and manpower and logistics supply services.
